summary: Full backend + frontend verification of 7HUES Expeditions homepage. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed (health, /api/content with correct hero copy & section counts, POST /api/bookings, 422 on missing required, 403 on admin endpoints without auth, 401 on /api/auth/me). Frontend: homepage loads past the '7HUES' loading screen; hero eyebrow + all 3 headline lines are visible in white (rgb(255,255,255), opacity 1, ~109px height each) - the suspected visibility bug is NOT present; play-showreel, runtime 01:24, hero-book-cta, site-header all render; header transitions from transparent (rgba(18,18,18,0.15), no blur) to blurred dark (rgba(18,18,18,0.79) + backdrop-filter blur(24px)) on scroll; all 5 nav links + nav-book-cta present. scroll-motorcycle in DOM; inline style updates on scroll (@800 -> left:50% top:0%, @2800 -> left:30.82% top:23.01% rotate 19.6deg) confirming scroll-driven motion. Winding road SVG present. All sections render with expected counts: 4 deliver-items, 6 experience tiles, 5 why-items, 3 social-posts, 3 journal-cards; section-what-we-do / how-we-deliver / experiences / why / people / from-the-road / journal all found. Footer shows 'THE WORLD IS CALLING.' & 'ANSWER IT.' plus footer-book-cta + all 3 social links. Booking flow: /book form submit with name/phone/email shows booking-success and creates record (verified via POST /api/bookings returning ok:true). Mobile menu (390px): menu-toggle opens mobile-menu with 5 nav links, menu-close closes it. 22 images on homepage, 0 broken; moto.png loads.

issues: The configured logo image (settings.logo, customer-assets URL) shows small vertical letters 'S/D/I/T' inside the circular badge, which reads oddly next to the '7HUES EXPEDITIONS' wordmark. Not a code bug — replace via CMS if undesired.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 455-line file — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting auth/media/content/bookings into modules as it grows.
GET /api/files/{path} calls remote storage synchronously via requests inside an async endpoint — will block the event loop under load. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_executor.
init_storage() uses sync requests during startup and every file op; storage_key is module-global without locking — fine now, but a race exists on cold start under concurrent requests.
Booking model uses str for email; consider EmailStr (already imported) for validation.
@app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan handlers.
Hero video autoplays with loop — no reduced-motion respect for the video (only RoadJourney respects prefersReducedMotion).
test_credentials: N/A - homepage & bookings are public; admin endpoints verified as 403 without auth.

If retesting, mobile menu-toggle requires ~1.5s wait after page load for the header slide-in animation before clicking (framer-motion initial y:-80). moto.png at /public/moto.png loads correctly and scroll-motorcycle inline style is driven by useMotionValueEvent - verify by scrolling to different Y positions and comparing the 'style' attribute (left/top/transform values differ).
